contract.intent: Context assembler (S3) — materializes per-node context packets (deterministic 6-layer, design §21.7), consumed by F5/F7 execution. Refuses unprovenanced facts, whole-tree packets, and LLM summarization overriding the deterministic skeleton.
acceptanceCriteria: 6-layer deterministic packet per node: path decisions, contract, resolved inputs (logical names), sibling status, binding state, open questions with provenance
Every fact carries a provenance label (derived-from / observation / inference / ask — resolution ladder)
No whole-tree packets: scope to the node needs
LLM summarization never overrides the deterministic skeleton
